guides.title: Claude Chat Provider · Connection
guides.description: Use Connection in Claude Chat Provider.
guides.before_you_start: Keep your existing values for a read-only tour. Opening this guide does not activate a provider, start services or apply settings.

steps.title: Read the Connection area first
steps.body: On the Claude provider page, read the Connection area before entering anything. It explains that an Anthropic API key from your own account is required. Use the explicit Test connection action to verify the key. No values are filled in for you.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Read a failed connection test
steps.body: If Test connection fails, recheck the key string and ensure no trailing whitespace was pasted. A failure does not necessarily signal an outage; malformed keys look similar. Retry once with the corrected value. Account-specific limits are not visible here.

steps.title: Choose a model from the selector
steps.body: After the Connection area shows a working key, use the model selector in the Model area to pick the Claude model you intend to use. The set of models shown depends on your Anthropic account. If the list is empty, retry Test connection rather than guessing a model name.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Choose a model for the intended input
steps.body: Read the model reported by the provider and choose one available to your account. Model selection does not change the saved API key. Availability and input support can differ between models, so use the provider's reported errors when diagnosing a later request rather than assuming every listed model behaves alike.

steps.title: Tune generation length and tone
steps.body: The Generation area groups sampling controls that influence reply length and style. Change one value, then ask a short question and compare. Very low values can make replies terse; very high values add tokens to request cost. Reset to defaults if you cannot remember what you changed, then reapply one adjustment.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Read failed generations as provider errors
steps.body: A generation that fails mid-stream often reflects a provider-side error or a limit on your Anthropic account. Retry once; if it persists, run Test connection to separate an auth problem from a service problem before editing generation controls.
